title: ArabJobs: A Multinational Corpus of Arabic Job Ads

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing gender-targeted advertisements to measure occupational segregation, calculating the gender pay gap across different countries and job categories, and performing concordance analysis to identify explicit gender filters and stereotyped emotional or soft skill framing.
Conducting concordance analysis to extract and evaluate explicit age limits and age-related preferences stated in job advertisements.
Using concordance analysis around appearance-related terms to identify explicit demands for physical attractiveness, grooming standards, and dress codes (e.g., 'not veiled').
Extracting and analyzing phrases via concordance analysis that stipulate a candidate's marital status (e.g., requiring candidates to be 'single' or 'not married') or family availability.
